services.desc: Every dollar donated to the Museum, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, supports its educational mission: to collect, preserve, and interpret the evolving history and traditions of country music. The Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum plays host to hundreds of field trips all year round - both in-person and virtually. Get started by booking your educational experience today! All prices are subject to change. Payment can be made in advance or on the day of the visit. All outreach programs are available to schools within a thirty-mile radius.
